claim_boundary: Replays the seven existing rank proofs and exact integral transports. Minimality certificates are retained from existing proofs. No new search, factorization, rank gain, record, or external submission.

minimality_source_certificate.argument: A nonminimal integral model at p requires v_p(c4)>=4, v_p(c6)>=6 and v_p(discriminant)>=12. Every prime dividing gcd(c4,c6) fails a necessary condition; other primes are excluded by the gcd.

replayed_rank_certificate_on_short_model.argument: Every integral relation is divisible by 2; E(Q)[2]=0 permits infinite descent. Hence all listed points are independent.

minimality_source_certificate.argument: A nonminimal integral model at p requires v_p(c4)>=4, v_p(c6)>=6 and v_p(discriminant)>=12. Each gcd prime either fails those valuations or has no integral model with scaled invariants c4/p^4,c6/p^6. Every p-integral Weierstrass equation admits p-integral translations normalizing a1,a3 to0 or1 and a2 to-1,0 or1: choose s using residues modulo2 when p=2 (otherwise2 is a unit), r using residues modulo3 when p=3 (otherwise3 is a unit), then t using residues modulo2. For each of these12 triples c4,c6 uniquely determine a4,a6 by the displayed b-invariant equations. A coefficient with denominator divisible by p in every candidate exclude a smaller integral model. Primes outside the gcd are excluded by invariant valuations.
